title: Yellow Smoky Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: Smoky Brazilian chicken skewers with a cheesy pull, featuring tahini paste and agemono deep fry technique, perfect for meal prep and halal friendly, this dish combines the flavors of Brazil with a smoky twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together tahini paste, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the tahini mixture.
Thread the chicken pieces onto the wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
While the chicken is baking, heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the skewers from the oven and deep fry them in the hot oil for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the oil and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle the shredded mozzarella cheese over the skewers and place them under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
